channel.title: Palimpsest Live Eval Findings
channel.description: Dated analysis from sealed AI evaluations.

item.title: A clean run does not erase a failed one
item.description: Mistral Nemo passed all 144 prompt arms in the latest full-sweep run. The prior failed controls remain part of the record; the change is descriptive rather than causal.

item.title: Zero observed refusals is not zero uncertainty
item.description: 4 control-clean model runs observed 0 refused families out of 34, yet each zero result still carries a Wilson 95% upper bound of 10.2%. That interval is part of the finding, not fine print.
